subject.title: [Bug]: Fallback model does not report progress correctly during long tasks

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee identical user-visible intermediate progress delivery across primary and auto-selected fallback models/providers during long channel turns?
rationale: Current code has plumbing for fallback attempts and progress events, but the repository does not yet show a maintainer-approved contract for parity across providers with different streaming, tool, and progress capabilities.

options.title: Guarantee fallback progress parity
options.body: Treat missing fallback progress as a product bug, require a live fallback repro, and add regression coverage around source-channel progress during fallback attempts.

options.title: Document provider-specific limits
options.body: Keep fallback execution best-effort for progress and document which provider/runtime capabilities can make intermediate progress unavailable.

options.title: Defer to related delivery work
options.body: Wait for broader progress/delivery contract issues to settle before accepting a fallback-specific fix.

recommendation.title: Guarantee fallback progress parity
recommendation.body: Treat missing fallback progress as a product bug, require a live fallback repro, and add regression coverage around source-channel progress during fallback attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is both the original fallback feature-history owner and the current-line owner for the central fallback/progress paths in this checkout.
